title: Error In City (Mirror The Artifact)
style: crash recovery anthem, 90 bpm, deadpan filename recital, terminal core, mirror-artifact rap, dry kick, sparse synth, recovery-doctrine vibe, ledger flow
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Cursor cursor crash error in city the filename
Two forty four KB twice mirrored same shame
Thirteen sixteen and twelve twenty four time stamp
Two copies one bug one lamp

[Pre-Chorus]
MD format markdown the body holds the trace
The city the cursor the crash place

[Chorus]
Error in city error in city
The markdown holds the bug pretty
Two forty four KB twice on the disk
Mirrored copies for the recovery whisk

[Verse 2]
Claudes web dot PDF one MB readable
Claudes web dot TXT three oh three KB editable
Same data two formats one event
The lane keeps both for the verdict bent

[Bridge]
Mirror the artifact the recovery rule
One format alone is the fragile fool

[Outro]
Error in city the filename held
Markdown plus PDF the lane compelled
